deals.name: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
deals.summary: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

deals.name: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
deals.summary: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

deals.name: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
deals.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

deals.name: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
deals.summary: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

deals.name: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
deals.summary: Science Corp. raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.

deals.name: Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a curated educational video platform for kids
deals.summary: Alongside CEO Leslie Morgan, Hank Green set out to create the video platform he wished his kid had.

deals.name: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
deals.summary: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

deals.name: Island is a new screen-time app that turns staying off your phone into a game
deals.summary: YC-backed Island turns screen time goals into a farming game, rewarding users with new crops, animals, and more when they stick to their limits.

deals.name: After dodging death, battery startup Our Next Energy is now going public
deals.summary: Our Next Energy is the latest battery startup to go public via SPAC. Does it now have what it needs to survive in the cutthroat battery industry?

deals.name: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
deals.summary: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.

deals.name: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
deals.summary: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies, including General Atomics.

deals.name: Flaming Hydra’s new Kickstarter campaign rethinks e-book ownership and digital lending
deals.summary: A new Kickstarter campaign aims to usher in the “return of the human internet.”

deals.name: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
deals.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

deals.name: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
deals.summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

deals.name: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
deals.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

deals.name: Investors break down how founders can raise a Series A today
deals.summary: Raising a Series A these days isn't so simple — top investors break down what founders need to know now.

deals.name: Thiel Capital’s Jack Selby nabs stakes in hot startups like Etched through Arizona connections
deals.summary: Selby's VC firm, Copper Sky Capital, is currently raising a $300 million second fund, according to a regulatory filing.

deals.name: Whoop’s valuation just tripled to $10 billion
deals.summary: The fitness tracking startup just closed a $575 million Series G with Cristiano Ronaldo and LeBron James among its investors. The obvious question looming over a round of this size at this valuation: Is an IPO coming?

deals.name: Modelence raises $3M to smooth out the vibe-coding stack
deals.summary: How do you build tooling for the AI software stack? A company called Modelence has an interesting answer.

deals.name: VC firm 2150 raises €210M fund to solve cities’ climate challenges
deals.summary: Europe-based venture fund 2150 raised the money to invest in climate tech startups that help solve cities' carbon footprint.

deals.name: Superorganism raises $25M to back biodiversity startups
deals.summary: Superorganism backs companies across three categories: tech that slows or reverses extinction, startups that operate at the intersection of climate and biodiversity, and tools that enable conservationists to do their work more effectively.

deals.name: More than 100 new tech unicorns were minted in 2025 — here they are
deals.summary: Using data from Crunchbase and PitchBook, TechCrunch tracked down the VC-backed startups that became unicorns so far this year.

deals.name: Supabase hit $5B by turning down million-dollar contracts. Here’s why.
deals.summary: Vibe coding has taken the tech industry by storm, and it’s not just the Lovables and Replits of the world that are winning. The startups building the infrastructure behind them are cashing in too.  Supabase, the open source database platform that’s become the bac

deals.name: Sequoia unveils $950M in new early-stage funds as it strives to be ‘only as good as our next investment’
deals.summary: The legendary firm launched a $750 million early-stage fund targeting Series A startups and a $200 million seed fund.

deals.name: Redwood Materials raises another $350M to power up its energy-storage business
deals.summary: The round was led by Eclipse and saw participation from Nvidia's venture capital arm, NVentures.

deals.name: A new search engine raises $1.1M to let obsessive fans dive down internet rabbit holes
deals.summary: Lore raises $1.1 million to build a personalized search engine for fandom culture.

deals.name: A year after filing to IPO, still-private Cerebras Systems raises $1.1B
deals.summary: Cerebras initially filed to go public in September 2024 but ran into several regulatory delays due to foreign investments.

deals.name: Doorstep raises $8M seed to help find missing food deliveries
deals.summary: Doorstep integrates into existing delivery apps and then, using phone sensors, tracks when a driver has entered a building, gone up an elevator, and made it to the desired doorstep.

deals.name: Why SecurityPal is choosing ‘nuanced capital’ over more VC rounds
deals.summary: During the venture capital crash of 2022, SecurityPal founder Pukar Hamal was just 14 months from running out of money. Rather than raise another round, he chose to restructure and focus on getting his business to profitability as quickly as possible — and he hasn’t raised

deals.name: Why Paradigm built a spreadsheet with an AI agent in every cell
deals.summary: Paradigm raised a $5 million seed round and is releasing it's AI-powered spreadsheet to the general public.

deals.name: NeoLogic wants to build more energy-efficient CPUs for AI data centers
deals.summary: To fund its vision of building more energy-efficient server CPUs, NeoLogic recently raised a $10 million Series A round led by KOMPAS VC with participation from M Ventures, Maniv Mobility, and lool Ventures.

deals.name: Amazon backs programmable optics startup Lumotive
deals.summary: Lumotive reopened its February Series B round to add Amazon's Industrial Innovation Fund and ITHCA Group, increasing the size of the round to $59 million.

deals.name: Three things veteran planetary health investors look for in a startup
deals.summary: RA Capital Planetary Health closed a $120 million fund. Here's the rubric two investors use to determine where to place their fund's money.

deals.name: AI voice company Hyper raises $6.3M to help automate 911 calls
deals.summary: Hyper hopes to use the fresh capital to help scale across the country, integrate more into existing 911 systems, hire a head of engineering, and build its next product.
